item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Mr. Trump, please give us a transformational Fed
item.description: The Fed models are wrong. Growth does not cause inflation. It is time for a transformational Fed

item.title: Starbucks removes cap on CEO's use of company's private jet, citing security concerns
item.description: Starbucks eliminates $250,000 cap on CEO Brian Niccol's personal jet use, allowing unlimited private aircraft travel following security recommendations.

item.title: Powell sidesteps questions on DOJ investigation, successor, administration criticism
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell dodges questions about a criminal probe and future plans in a tense news conference after the central bank's rate cut decision Wednesday.

item.title: Powell says Americans forced to 'economize' as stubborn inflation squeezes household budgets
item.description: Fed Chair Jerome Powell reveals American consumers are struggling and looking to "economize" purchases amid stubborn inflation, as central bank holds rates steady.

item.title: Steak 'n Shake pledges $1K contributions to Trump Accounts for employees' children
item.description: Steak 'n Shake pledges $1,000 matching contributions to "Trump Accounts" for employees' children born between 2025 and 2028, joining corporate support initiative.

item.title: Tesla ends production of Model S and Model X vehicles, will focus on robots in 2026
item.description: Tesla pivots from electric vehicles to autonomous technology as Elon Musk announces the discontinuation of Model S and Model X to focus on mass-producing Optimus robots.

item.title: Instacart slaps NYC shoppers with surprise ‘regulatory response fee’ after new city law kicks in
item.description: Instacart added a $5.99 "Regulatory Response Fee" to NYC orders after the passage of new worker protection laws requiring a $21.44-per-hour minimum wage for drivers.

item.title: Disney World, Universal Orlando close water parks as unusually cold weather hits Florida
item.description: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon and Universal's Volcano Bay are experiencing temporary closures as Central Florida temperatures plunge below seasonal averages.

item.title: Home Depot cuts 800 jobs, orders corporate staff back to office full time
item.description: Home Depot said it will eliminate about 800 jobs tied to its Atlanta store support center and require corporate employees to return to the office full time.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase to offer $1K match for Trump Accounts belonging employees’ kids
item.description: JPMorgan Chase announced it will match the federal government’s $1,000 contribution to Trump Accounts belonging to eligible employees’ children.
